tools.name: check_assessment
tools.description: Fairness check for a Maryland property assessment: where the address sits among genuinely similar homes (same reassessment group, similar size/lot/age, same zip), the group's median sales ratio, verdict branch (fair/review/elevated/insufficient), and Maryland's appeal windows with official filing li

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_assessment · Public sink: check_assessment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_assessment · Public sink: check_assessment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
